Texture hint: Whether to generate textures. Turn off for pure geometry without textures.
PBR materials hint: Generate base_color, metallic, roughness, normal and other PBR maps. Enabling this turns on texturing automatically.
Geometry quality hint: Geometry quality tier. Ultra gives finer geometry detail (extra cost).
Topology hint: P2 outputs quad faces by default for easier DCC editing. Current face limit 1,500,000.
Geometry seed hint: Random seed for geometry. Same seed + same input yields the same mesh.
Texture seed hint: Random seed for textures. Same seed yields the same texture.
Texture alignment hint: original_image matches input colors first; geometry matches generated geometry first.
Model orientation hint: default auto-orient; align_image aligns the model to the input image view. Only applies when texturing is on.
Real-world scale hint: Scale the model to real-world size (meters), for AR/VR or game engines.
Art style hint: Generate handcrafted-style, clean-topology low-poly models. Complex models may fail.
Geometry compression hint: Enable meshopt compression to reduce file size.
UV unwrap hint: Unwrap UVs during generation. Turn off to speed up and reduce size (textures still handle it).
Part generation hint: Generate editable segmented parts. Mutually exclusive with texture/PBR/quads — turn those off first.
Prompt is required: Enter a model description or upload a reference image
